notes: Operator-pinned pricing source for RI-7.8b-bc10 real-adapter usage/cost aggregate evidence.
This file is bound by SHA-256 digest into RI-7.8b-bc10-6b supersession entry and 6b evidence.
Runtime activation guard (scripts/ri78b_bc10_activation_window.py) re-computes SHA-256 of this file and fail-closes on mismatch.
Per-call markers + 6c aggregate compute actual_cost_usd using input_tokens * input_cost_per_1k_tokens_usd / 1000 + output_tokens * output_cost_per_1k_tokens_usd / 1000.
currency=USD; cost values are decimal strings to preserve precision; precision_decimal_places=8 supports gpt-4o-mini's $0.00015/1k granular pricing without float rounding errors.
Provider-side pricing may change; this is a frozen operator-pinned snapshot for the bounded bc10 window.
